title: Rademacher for f∘Φ: a.e. differentiability of a locally Lipschitz map composed with a C¹ map
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be locally Lipschitz on U, and let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be of class C¹. Then for Lⁿ-a.e. w ∈ ℝⁿ (Lⁿ = volume): if Φ(w) ∈ U, then f∘Φ is (Fréchet) differentiable at w.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → ∀ᵐ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n)), Φ w ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w
